addr: 754, 19th Main Rd, 22nd Cross Rd, Sector 2, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: Great Coworking space! Seating area is clean and inviting with comfortable chairs. …
Nice co-working space! I’ve been working here for the past five months. Being on the 4th floor with seats close to the windows allows plenty of natural light, making it a great place to work.

The amenities are fantastic, with high-speed internet and meeting rooms equipped with everything you need for a successful video call or brainstorming session. The staff is incredibly helpful and always available to assist with any requests, whether it’s tech support or something more specific
